entities.name: Gnaeus Arulenus Caelius Sabinus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gnaeus Arulenus Caelius Sabinus was a Roman senator, who was active during the Year of Four Emperors. He was suffect consul in the nundinium of April through June of 69 AD as the colleague of his brother Titus Flavius Sabinus.
